newsitem.title: INDIA: India HCL to buy 30,000T copper cathode from Chile.
newsitem.headline: India HCL to buy 30,000T copper cathode from Chile.

text.p: India's state-owned Hindustan Copper Ltd (HCL) will buy 30,000 tonnes of LME 'A' grade copper cathodes from Chile's Codelco for conversion into copper wire rods, a company official said on Friday.
The official said an agreement was signed between HCL and Codelco on December 10 for the copper cathodes imports in 1997/98 (April-March).
The conversion will take place in HCL's Taloja plant in the western state of Maharashtra, he said.
"We have already obtained our requirements of cathodes from Codelco for the current financial year," the official said. He gave no details.
HCL, India's largest copper firm, annually produces some 50,000 tonnes of copper and meets 35 percent of the country's domestic demand. The rest is met through imports.
